segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally tolerate this retinol well when introduced gradually and paired with a moisturizer or the 'sandwich' method, several noting some initial stinging or a slight increase in breakouts that eased over time, and warning that skipping moisturizer can lead to peeling.
segments.dry: The reviewers who mention dry skin, alongside other skin traits, say the retinol did not dry out their skin further when paired with a moisturizer.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report smaller-looking pores and smoother texture with regular use, several saying it caused no breakouts or irritation despite oily skin often reacting poorly to new products.
segments.combination: The reviewers who mention combination skin, generally alongside oiliness or sensitivity, report smoother texture and visibly smaller pores with regular use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their mid-40s through 70s report visible improvement in skin smoothness and pore size, one noting results come more gradually than with a stronger prescription retinoid.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report visibly softer or fading fine lines within weeks of regular use, though one reviewer using it for about two months says her wrinkles and hyperpigmentation are still noticeably present and she's unsure if she needs more time.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the retinol as lightweight and hydrating or at least non-drying when used as directed with a moisturizer, but several report significant dryness, flaking, or peeling when they used it too often, too much, or skipped moisturizing afterward.
concerns.redness: The one reviewer who describes redness-prone sensitive skin says this retinol fit well into her routine without the stinging she gets from most products, though results were slower than with stronger retinoids.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer says the product has helped heal her skin barrier and fade dark spots, while another separately warns that using more than the recommended pea-sized amount is the fastest way to damage the skin barrier.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading dark spots, acne marks, or hyperpigmentation within weeks of regular use, though one reviewer after about two months says her hyperpigmentation is still noticeably present, and another notes it helped acne marks fade to pink but didn't fully even out her skin tone.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, or faded acne scars with regular use, often after an initial purging period; however, some report new or worse breakouts, including one who reacted specifically to the niacinamide in the formula and another who broke out after overusing the product.

aspects.libelle: A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: After 3 months of use, I can conclude that this does not work. My derm prescribed me better topicals than this over the counter brand. I was looking for a cheaper alternative but my skin looks the same. Didnt fix any dark spots or wrinkles

I've had acne prone skin for over a decade. my skincare focus has always been acne based, but now at 31 I've been looking to add more anti-aging products in. I figured a gentle retinol would be great, as it'd help both acne and fine lines. as soon as I started using this, I started breaking out. after taking a deeper look at the ingredients list, I found niacinamide was in it. I can't use products with niacinamide and ALWAYS break out when I find it in skincare I'm using. niacinamide is in just way too much nowadays and after I was getting it in high doses from different products, it started wreaking havoc on my skin and I can no longer use it. if cerava products break you out, check the ingredients. Their products almost ALWAYS contain niacinamide. PLEASE make some niacinamide free products!!!

I am surprised by this product, no purging, no irritation. It looks like a small bottle but I am still using my first ordered May 31st. I use this 5 days out of 7. I have very oily skin, but no acne or breakouts, I also am dealing with 70 year old skin. I have noticed a difference in the smoothness of my skin and pore size. I use the CeraVe renewing night cream with this. I am very happy with this product.

extraits.titre: Great for Sensitive Skin and Beginners
extraits.texte: This is my first time using retinol and I've been using it for about 2 months now. For context, I have combination to dry, sensitive skin and I'm in my early 20s. Aging isn't my main concern yet, but I want to start introducing products like this into my routine for the future. I do have some fine lines (from school and working in customer service) and occasional breakouts, but my main concerns are sun damage and hyperpigmentation. I'm very pale and burn easily, and because I didn't use sunscreen consistently as a teen, some sun damage is already visible. I was hesitant to start retinol because I worried about purging and peeling, and I did experience a slight increase in breakouts, but nothing extreme. I began using it twice a week at night with the "retinol sandwich" method, applying a lightweight moisturizer or hydrating toner first to prevent dryness, then a pea-sized amount of retinol, followed by another layer of moisturizer. It takes a little practice to spread such a small amount evenly across the face, but I've managed to make it work (Please stick to the recommended amount. Using more is the fastest way to damage your skin barrier). After about two weeks, I tried applying it on bare skin, which my skin tolerated, and then I resumed the sandwich method while increasing use to three times a week, hoping to eventually build up to daily use. I also tried it a few times on my neck following the same method, and it seems to tolerate it well. The serum has a slightly yello

This has changed the game for my skin!! I have been using this product for 4 months now and can't imagine it not being in my routine. It is so so amazing. I followed the "every 3 days for 1 month, every other day for 1 month and then every day from there on out" routine and my skin did not break out or have any adverse reactions (I have oily skin and new products often make me breakout). I have noticed my fine lines going away since using. Because only a pea size amount is needed, the product lasts for very long. It is also so affordable! I will be repurchasing over and over again.

I have been using this product off and on for over a year. I have very sensitive skin that is prone to redness and stings when I apply most products. I'm 44 years old and was looking for a retinol that wouldn't irritate my skin. This one really fit well into my skincare regimen. It's not as harsh as others that I've tried, but still makes a visible difference- just probably not as quickly as other stronger products. I would recommend this for anyone with sensitive skin. If you don't have sensitive skin, a product with stronger retinol might show results faster.

My skin is pretty normal but with texture issues and current perimenopausal breakouts. I've been using other well known brands of retinol for years with no results. I bought this because I was looking specifically for something to help with my texture. Well, within a week of using this the texture issues on my left cheek literally disappeared! I can't stop touching my face, it's so soft and smooth! My boyfriend even noticed the improvement in my skin. I've had texture issues for years and only wish I found this product sooner. My other retinol is going in the trash and this is going to be my new holy grail. I also just got the SA cleanser. Neither of these products have dried out my normal to dry sensitive skin either.

reserve: A large share of the reviews supplied describe washing or foaming with the product, staining fabric, or specific benzoyl-peroxide percentages, which are hallmarks of a different CeraVe cleanser rather than this retinol cream, so this reading relies only on the subset of reviews that clearly describe a leave-on retinol or serum.
